newsitem.title: USA: Caterpillar jumps on higher profit, outlook.
newsitem.headline: Caterpillar jumps on higher profit, outlook.

text.p: Shares of Caterpillar Inc were up almost three percent Tuesday, after the heavy equipment maker reported earnings much higher than analysts' expectations and forecast growing profit for the year.
Caterpillar reported earnings of $394 million, or $2.08 a share for the first quarter, well above the mean analysts' estimate of $1.69 a share.
The company also said it expects 1997 profits to be higher than the $1.4 billion, or $7.07 a share, reported for 1996, based on sales that it expects to be moderately higher.
The profit outlook is a switch from January, when the company forecast profits near 1996 levels.
"This is just a very, very solid operating quarter," J. Blair Brumley, analyst at Dain Bosworth, said.
Caterpillar shares were up 2-3/8 at 81-3/4 tuesday.
